name: Arab Pharmaceuticals Company
source: stockanalysis.com (secondary data provider, figures as reported by that provider, not read from the exchange filing)
note: Figures in the unit shown, converted from the provider's millions EGP. Each fiscal year header cell was matched to its own data cell, so the provider trailing twelve month column is excluded. Every printed identity ties: revenue less cost of sales equals gross profit, and profit before tax less income tax equals net profit. Net profit for periods carrying a minority interest is the profit for the year before that interest, which the provider prints as earnings from continuing operations. Net Change in Cash is withheld for the period(s) where the provider printed a figure that did not equal Operating plus Investing plus Financing cash flow; the difference is the provider adjustment row this panel does not show.
